column1: # True extents for the ingest stage `interior` (tools/stages/interior.py; lane tidy 2026-11-02).
# A row rewrites the extern declarator `symbol[from]` -> `symbol[to]` in that game file before the
# interior analysis.  Each row is a decomp extent GUESS (an over-long array) that chained separate
# data-layer objects into one interior group with members past the root's declared extent; `to` is
# the data layer's extent (data2c object size / bss label span, checked by `interior.py --check`).
# Generated by `interior.py --propose-extents`, reviewed: every use is index 0, an index proven in
# range, or the address (strings / SJIS glyph keys passed to a callee).
# Lane tidy2 (2026-11-02) widened the proposer to every over-declared member of a component (an
# extent past the data-layer object that covers another used label), not only past-extent chains:
# +382 rows (401 -> 57 defines).  Its use scan (interior.py scan_uses) passed 367; the 15 rows with
# `; reviewed:` in the evidence were #FLAG rows proven in range by hand; 10 declarations stay routed
# (uses past the true extent: structs / tables the data layer splits into labels; out/tidy2/REPORT.md).
